scope: Centered command material over remote page content; compact address editor stays opaque

implementation.placement: Inside the owner ChildView above the page compositor; live input and result popup remain above it

comparison.method: Sky captures of Arc and the disposable candidate using the same local black/white page; raw neutral pixel values

limitations: Sky captures the owning window and omits the separate Gecko popup's text and result layers; the opaque baseline has the same limitation.
Neutral material and shadow measurements do not establish complete composited pixel, text-raster or accessibility equivalence.
The images are uncalibrated captures on this Mac; arbitrary colored-page and display-profile equivalence is not certified.
Physical trackpad physics, all-Space visual parity and faster-than-Arc performance remain separate open work.
